The '''Darpa sector''', also known as the '''Ralltiir sector''', was in the [[Ringali Shell]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], and [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]]. It once contained the [[Esselian Empire]].

==History==
In the years before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Darpa sector was ruled by royal families, including the [[Royal Octans]], who gained their wealth as [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]]. The [[Margrave Octan]] of [[Nallastia]], and his descendant, the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] ([[Skull Queen]] of Nallastia), were among the prominent posterity of the Royal Octans.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives in this sector were listed in [[Datacard/Legends|datapacks]] recovered from the base on [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]]. These lists were discovered by a young technician aboard [[Elusive (transport)|''Elusive'']], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] transport ship ''en route'' from Dankayo to [[Tolan]]. The Dankayo Rebels reportedly supervised intelligence operations in three sectors. Thus, Ralltiir was presumably one of the three.

During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jander Graffe]].<ref name="AJ7">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref>

The sector was partially invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], during which time the invaders took Ralltiir and Rhinnal.
